An Armed Services member buying an aerospace and defense name is exactly the profile that draws disclosure scrutiny, which can cut against the position independently of fundamentals.
All congressional amounts are bands; the aggregate could be far smaller than the count of filings implies.
picks.invalidation: Delaney's tranche buying stops or turns into disclosed sales, or no further non-Delaney buyer appears, while price falls back toward the 90-day low of 1148.97.
